name: Gloomvex
storyline:
On a hostile alien world consumed by darkness and corruption, the remnants of humanity face an endless swarm of unknown creatures. As one of the last survivors, you enter the arena to fight, adapt, and uncover the power hidden within the ruins of Gloomvex.

Each run brings new threats, stronger enemies, and dangerous choices. By collecting resources, defeating bosses, and unlocking powerful upgrades, you push deeper into a world shaped by cosmic energy, hostile evolution, and relentless survival.
summary:
Gloomvex is a dark sci-fi arena roguelite about surviving relentless enemy waves on a hostile alien world.

Fight your way through increasingly dangerous runs, collect gold and experience, unlock upgrades, and shape your build with weapons, stats, and powerful augments. Each run pushes you to adapt quickly, improve your damage output, manage movement, and survive against growing swarms of enemies and powerful bosses.

With permanent progression, escalating difficulty, and a grim sci-fi atmosphere, Gloomvex focuses on fast survival combat, build optimization, and the constant push to become stronger with every attempt.
